page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.6xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The CPU configuration provides 1 thread per core, supported by a cache hierarchy of 48 KB L1d, 1 MB L2, and 48 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.g7.6xlarge in the average performance tier across most standardized tests. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is recorded at 1836.29, while the multi-core score reaches 23245.48. Memory bandwidth tests show 1267.06 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 128.31 GB/sec for large-block reads and 63.76 GB/sec for large-block writes. In computational workloads, the instance achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 11454.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 28981.96. Notably, the server demonstrates strong performance in LLM text generation using a small 135M model, reaching 282.28 tokens/sec, which falls into the top 25% category, though prompt processing for the same model remains average at 1803.7 tokens/sec.

The lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, limiting this instance's utility for heavy local database caching or complex deep learning training. However, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer stable, predictable resource density for general-purpose enterprise workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications requiring consistent CPU performance without the premium of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The instance is suited for workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale language model inference.
